question: PCSK9 inhibitors lower LDL-cholesterol by preventing degradation of hepatic LDL receptors, thereby increasing the number of receptors available to clear LDL from the circulation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. PCSK9 inhibitors are monoclonal antibodies that block PCSK9 from degrading hepatic LDL receptors, leading to more receptors on the hepatocyte surface and greater LDL uptake from plasma.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. PCSK9 normally binds to LDL receptors and targets them for lysosomal degradation. Inhibiting PCSK9 (with evolocumab or alirocumab) preserves LDL receptors, dramatically increasing LDL clearance — LDL-C falls by up to 60% on top of statin therapy.
